                # Sanitize dates: filter price keys to valid cabins only
                _VALID_CABINS = {"business", "economy", "basic_economy", "premium_economy", "first"}

content = content.replace(old_flights_block, new_flights_block)

with open('skills/tau2Airline/src/tau2/domains/airline/data_model.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Patches applied successfully")
"""
